sections.body: Gemäß dem türkischen Datenschutzgesetz Nr. 6698 ("KVKK") werden Ihre personenbezogenen Daten von Beeyondapps als Verantwortlicher im nachfolgend beschriebenen Umfang verarbeitet.
sections.title: 1. Verantwortlicher

sections.body:
Über unsere Anwendung werden folgende personenbezogene Daten erhoben:
- Identitätsdaten: Name, Nachname, Profilbild
- Kontaktdaten: E-Mail-Adresse
- Standortdaten: Ungefährer Standort auf Stadtebene
- Kontodaten: Passwort (verschlüsselt), Spracheinstellungen, Herkunftsland
- Nutzungsdaten: App-Interaktionen, besuchte Veranstaltungen, beigetretene Gemeinschaften
- Gerätedaten: Gerätetyp, Betriebssystem, Push-Benachrichtigungs-Tokens
- Nachrichtendaten: Direktnachrichten zwischen Nutzern (verschlüsselt)
- Zahlungsdaten: Zahlungen werden über Shopier abgewickelt; Kreditkarten- oder Bankdaten werden von uns nicht gespeichert.
sections.title: 2. Erhobene personenbezogene Daten

sections.body:
Ihre personenbezogenen Daten werden zu folgenden Zwecken verarbeitet:
- Verwaltung der Mitgliedschaft und Kontoerstellung
- Bereitstellung und Verbesserung der Anwendungsdienste
- Anzeige von Veranstaltungen und Gemeinschaften in Ihrer Nähe
- Ermöglichung der Kommunikation zwischen Nutzern
- Versand von Push-Benachrichtigungen (Veranstaltungserinnerungen, Nachrichten)
- Abwicklung von Ticketzahlungen über Shopier
- Überwachung der App-Stabilität und Fehlerbehebung
- Übersetzung von Inhalten zwischen Sprachen
- Erfüllung gesetzlicher Verpflichtungen

— Messung der Werbeleistung auf Meta (Facebook/Instagram) und Google Ads, Attributionsverfolgung (welche Anzeige welchen Nutzer gebracht hat) und Anzeigenoptimierung.
— Versand von Service-Mitteilungen, Produktaktualisierungen und — vorbehaltlich Ihrer Einwilligung — Marketing- / Werbeinformationen.
sections.title: 3. Zwecke der Datenverarbeitung

sections.body:
Ihre personenbezogenen Daten werden auf Grundlage folgender Rechtsgrundlagen gemäß KVKK Artikel 5/2 verarbeitet:
- Verarbeitung ist für die Erfüllung eines Vertrags erforderlich (Mitgliedschaftsvertrag)
- Verarbeitung ist für die berechtigten Interessen des Verantwortlichen erforderlich
- Ihre ausdrückliche Einwilligung (für Marketingkommunikation)
- Verarbeitung ist zur Erfüllung einer rechtlichen Verpflichtung erforderlich
sections.title: 4. Rechtsgrundlage der Verarbeitung
5. Übermittlung personenbezogener Daten
sections.body:
Zur Bereitstellung unserer Dienste werden Ihre personenbezogenen Daten ausschließlich für die genannten Zwecke an folgende Dienstleister übermittelt:
- Supabase Inc.: Datenbank, Authentifizierung und Dateispeicherung (EU – Server in Irland)
- Vercel Inc.: Hosting der Web-App
- Google LLC – Firebase Analytics: Nutzungsanalyse der App (Nutzer-ID, aufgerufene Bildschirme, In-App-Ereignisse, Gerätedaten)
- Google LLC – Firebase Crashlytics: Absturzberichte
- Google LLC – Firebase Cloud Messaging: Zustellung von Push-Benachrichtigungen
- Google LLC – Gemini, Cloud Translation und Vertex AI: Automatische Übersetzung von Beiträgen, Kommentaren und Fragen, Spracherkennung und Suche nach ähnlichen Fragen (die von Ihnen geteilten Texte)
- Google LLC – Google Maps: Auswahl von Stadt und Veranstaltungsort (Suchtext; Gerätekoordinaten bei der Standortauswahl)
- Google LLC – Google-Anmeldung und Play Install Referrer: Anmeldung; unter Android Erkennung des Kanals, über den Sie die App installiert haben
- Apple Inc.: Anmeldung mit Apple und Benachrichtigungsinfrastruktur
- Functional Software Inc. (Sentry): Fehler- und Leistungsüberwachung (EU – Server in Deutschland)
- Meta Platforms Inc. (Facebook/Instagram): Messung der Werbeleistung (App-Ereignisse, Web-Pixel und Conversions API). E-Mail-Adresse, Telefonnummer und Nutzer-ID werden vor der Übermittlung SHA-256-gehasht; die Werbe-ID Ihres Geräts wird nur mit Ihrer Erlaubnis verwendet.
- Shopier (Türkei): Zahlungen für Veranstaltungstickets und Expertengespräche. Ihre Kartendaten geben Sie direkt bei Shopier ein; Newbee sieht und speichert sie nicht.
- Tremendous Inc.: Auszahlungen an Veranstalter (nur Name, E-Mail-Adresse und Auszahlungsbetrag des Veranstalters)
- Unser E-Mail-Versanddienstleister: Versand von Ticket- und Informations-E-Mails
- QuickChart: Erstellung des QR-Codes in Ticket-E-Mails (nur der Ticketcode)
- Fly.io: Einmalige Passwortprüfung für Nutzer, die von der alten Newbee-App wechseln

Unsere Hauptdatenbank befindet sich in der Europäischen Union (Irland), die Fehlerüberwachung in Deutschland; einige Dienstleister (Google, Meta, Vercel, Tremendous) können Daten auch in anderen Ländern, einschließlich der USA, verarbeiten. Internationale Datenübermittlungen erfolgen in Übereinstimmung mit KVKK Artikel 9.

Ihre personenbezogenen Daten werden gespeichert, solange Ihr Konto aktiv ist. Bei Löschung Ihres Kontos werden Ihre Daten innerhalb von 30 Tagen entfernt. Anonymisierte Nutzungsstatistiken können zu Analysezwecken weiterhin gespeichert werden. Sicherheitsprotokolle werden 90 Tage aufbewahrt.
sections.title: 6. Speicherdauer

sections.body:
Zum Schutz Ihrer personenbezogenen Daten werden folgende technische und organisatorische Maßnahmen getroffen:
- Alle Daten werden über HTTPS/TLS 1.2+ übertragen
- Anmeldedaten werden mit iOS Keychain und Android EncryptedSharedPreferences gespeichert
- Row-Level Security (RLS) stellt sicher, dass Nutzer nur auf ihre eigenen Daten zugreifen können
- Nachrichten werden verschlüsselt gespeichert
- Einhaltung der OWASP MASVS L2-Standards
sections.title: 7. Datensicherheitsmaßnahmen

sections.body:
Gemäß KVKK Artikel 11 haben Sie folgende Rechte:
- Zu erfahren, ob Ihre personenbezogenen Daten verarbeitet werden
- Auskunft über die Verarbeitung Ihrer Daten zu verlangen
- Den Zweck der Verarbeitung und die zweckgemäße Nutzung zu erfahren
- Die Dritten zu kennen, an die Ihre Daten im In- oder Ausland übermittelt werden
- Berichtigung unvollständiger oder unrichtiger Daten zu verlangen
- Löschung oder Vernichtung Ihrer Daten gemäß KVKK Artikel 7 zu verlangen
- Benachrichtigung Dritter über Berichtigungen und Löschungen zu verlangen
- Widerspruch gegen Ergebnisse automatisierter Datenanalyse einzulegen
- Schadensersatz bei rechtswidriger Verarbeitung zu verlangen

Sie können Ihre Rechte über folgende Wege ausüben:

kvkk/en.title: Clarification Text on Processing of Personal Data (KVKK)

sections.title: Introduction
sections.body:
Data Controller: Beeyondapps Ltd. (“Newbee” or “Company”)
E-mail: info@beeyondapps.com
Effective Date: 01.01.2023 (Updated: 25.09.2026)
At Newbee, we place the utmost importance on the privacy of our users (“Member”) and the protection of their personal data. This Clarification Text has been prepared in accordance with the Law No. 6698 on the Protection of Personal Data (“KVKK”) to inform you about the purposes for which your data is processed, to whom it is transferred, and your legal rights.

sections.title: Personal Data Processed
sections.body:
Within the scope of your use of the Newbee platform, the following data is processed:
•	Identity and Contact Information: Name, surname, email address, date of birth (for age verification), profile picture, country/city of origin, and current residence. Your phone number when you buy a ticket.
•	Content and Interaction Data: Posts, comments, questions, direct messages, groups joined, and event registrations.
•	Technical and Device Data: IP address, device model, operating system, in-app activity logs, push notification token, browser information and — if you allow it — your device's advertising identifier.
•	Payment Data: For event tickets and expert sessions, your card details are processed directly by the licensed payment institution Shopier; Newbee never sees or stores them. After payment, Shopier sends us the name, email and phone number on the order.
•	Geolocation Data: Location information collected, subject to your permission, for city selection, event management and personalization.

sections.title: Purposes of Processing Personal Data
sections.body:
Your personal data are processed for the following purposes:
•	Creating your account and securing it.
•	Facilitating newcomer integration by building community connections.
•	Ensuring content safety, automatic translation, language detection and finding similar questions via Google AI services (Gemini, Cloud Translation, Vertex AI).
•	Managing online and in-person events, tracking tickets and reservations, and processing payments and refunds.
•	Analysing app usage and detecting and fixing errors and crashes.
•	Measuring ad performance on Meta (Facebook/Instagram) and Google Ads, attribution tracking (identifying which ad drove each user), and ad optimization.
•	Sending service announcements and product updates by push notification and email and — subject to your consent — marketing / promotional communications.
•	R&D with anonymized data to improve user experience.
•	Meeting legal obligations (e.g. combating CSAM and reporting to judicial authorities).

For the fulfillment of the aforementioned purposes, your data may be shared with:
•	Service Providers: Hosting, cloud infrastructure, artificial intelligence (Google Gemini), and payment system providers.
•	Other Members: Due to the nature of the platform, information shared on your profile and made public by you is visible to other users.
•	Legal Authorities: Authorized judicial and administrative bodies upon legal request or as required by legislation.
sections.title: Transfer of Personal Data
International Transfer of Personal Data
sections.body:
Newbee is a globally operated platform. Because our technology stack is hosted abroad, your data is transferred to servers outside your country. Our main database is in the European Union (Ireland) and our error monitoring is in Germany; some of our service providers (Google, Meta, Vercel, Tremendous) may also process data in other countries, including the United States. This transfer is carried out within the scope of the platform's core operation (performance of contract) and your explicit consent.

To provide our Services, we share personal data with the following service providers, only for the purposes listed:
- Supabase Inc.: Database, authentication and file storage (EU – Ireland servers)
- Vercel Inc.: Hosting of the web app
- Google LLC – Firebase Analytics: App usage analytics (user ID, screens viewed, in-app events, device information)
- Google LLC – Firebase Crashlytics: Crash reports
- Google LLC – Firebase Cloud Messaging: Push notification delivery
- Google LLC – Gemini, Cloud Translation and Vertex AI: Automatic translation of posts, comments and questions, language detection and finding similar questions (the text you share)
- Google LLC – Google Maps: City and venue selection (search text; device coordinates when you pick a location)
- Google LLC – Google Sign-In and Play Install Referrer: Signing in; on Android, identifying which channel you installed the app from
- Apple Inc.: Sign in with Apple and notification infrastructure
- Functional Software Inc. (Sentry): Error and performance monitoring (EU – Germany servers)
- Meta Platforms Inc. (Facebook/Instagram): Ad performance measurement (app events, web pixel and Conversions API). Your email address, phone number and user ID are SHA-256 hashed before transmission; your device's advertising identifier is used only if you allow it.
- Shopier (Türkiye): Payments for event tickets and expert sessions. You enter your card details directly with Shopier; Newbee never sees or stores them.
- Tremendous Inc.: Payouts to event organizers (only the organizer's name, email address and payout amount)
- Our email delivery provider: Sending ticket and information emails
- QuickChart: Generating the QR code in ticket emails (ticket code only)
- Fly.io: One-time password verification for users moving over from the old Newbee app

All international data transfers comply with KVKK Article 9.

Your data is collected through automated methods via the mobile application, website, and email channels. Processing activities are based on the legal grounds of: "establishment or performance of a contract," "fulfillment of the data controller's legal obligation," and "legitimate interests of the data controller, provided that it does not prejudice the fundamental rights and freedoms of the data subject."
sections.title: Method and Legal Basis for Data Collection

sections.body:
Pursuant to Article 11 of the KVKK, you have the right to:
•	Learn whether your data is being processed,
•	Request information if processed,
•	Request correction of incorrectly processed data,
•	Request deletion or destruction of your data (Account deletion request),
•	Claim compensation for damages arising from unlawful processing.
For all requests and inquiries, please contact us at info@beeyondapps.com.

At Newbee, we believe that every newcomer deserves to feel at home. Whether you’re looking for local insights, essential services, or connections with people from your home country, Newbee ensures a safe, structured, and privacy-focused space for you to navigate life abroad with confidence.
Your privacy and trust are our top priorities. This policy outlines how we collect, use, and protect your information to enhance your experience while keeping your data secure.
We invite you to read this Privacy Policy (“Privacy Policy”), which explains our privacy practices and how we handle personal information collected through Newbee, our marketing activities, our live events, from third party sources, and other activities described in this Privacy Policy. This Privacy Policy also explains how we use and share such information and choices you have about your personal information.
We use “Newbee” to refer to the Newbee websites and our iOS and Android apps. Those websites and apps, and any other services we offer, are referred to as our “Services.” We also use “Newbee,” “we,” “us,” and “our” to refer to the companies operating our Services. Unless otherwise indicated, this Privacy Policy applies to all our Services in all geographies in which Newbee offers its Services.
sections.title: Welcome to Newbee!

sections.body: We may collect personal information about you from you directly, from other Members or other users of our Services, through technology that automatically collects information from your browser or device, and from third party sources. See below for examples. Note that not all Newbee account types and features are available in all locations, so some of the examples below may not apply where you live. Additionally, these examples are not exhaustive and we may collect personal information that is not specifically listed below, which we use consistent with this Privacy Policy. We may also provide supplemental information about our data collection or privacy practices in disclosures about specific Services or circumstances, or in some cases, at the time we collect personal information from you. Any personal information that we collect will be used and processed in a manner consistent with this Privacy Policy.
sections.title: 1	What Personal Information Is Collected?
1.1	Personal information we may collect from you
sections.body:
•	Your personal details.
o	When you sign up for Newbee, you will need to provide certain information about yourself, such as your name, email address, and the city/country you came from and currently reside in. In certain jurisdictions, you may also be required to provide your date of birth or other information to verify your age. You may also choose to provide other personal details, either when you sign up or later, such as a profile picture, your date of birth, your gender, race or ethnicity, and demographic information. Additionally, you may choose to reveal information about yourself in your Newbee profile, or when you post or comment on Newbee.
o	If you contact support, you will need to provide us with your contact information along with a description of the issue for us to be able to respond or provide support to you.
•	Data from other accounts. If you use Google or Apple to log in to Newbee, you authorize that service to share your personal information with us, such as your name, photo and email address.
•	Information you share about yourself and your community.
o	You may share information about yourself in your profile, including your interests, skills, a profile photo and biographical information (such as your job, hometown, or how long you have lived in the area).
o	You may post on Newbee. Posts may include text, images, photos, polls, events or anything else you want to share.
o	You may ask and answer questions and send direct messages on Newbee.
o	You may share information about your interests, including by joining and/or posting in a Group, RSVPing to an event, or following a city, community or topic.
•	Payment information. For event tickets and expert sessions, you enter your card details directly with our payment provider Shopier; Newbee never sees or stores them. After payment, Shopier sends us the name, email address and phone number on the order.
•	Survey data. We may contact some Members to request participation in a survey or other general research. If you choose to take part, you may provide personal information in or along with your responses.
•	Contests, and prize drawings data. If you take part in a contest, or prize drawing, then you may provide personal information, feedback, or comments in order to enter.
•	Messages and email data. We collect information about you when you send, receive, open, read or otherwise engage with messages, email, or other communications in connection with our Services, including whether you have opened or acted on those communications.
•	Images and photos. You may choose to give our Services permission to access your device's camera and photo library, for example to add a profile photo or images to your posts, or to scan a ticket QR code.
•	Geolocation. You may choose to grant our Services permission to access your device's location, which we use to select your city and personalize our Services.

With your permission, where it is required by applicable laws, we, our service providers, and partners collect technical information when you visit or use Newbee, engage with our partners, or interact with Newbee’s or our partners’ marketing communications, including:
•	Device data. Device data may include your device’s manufacturer and model, operating system and version, screen resolution, RAM and disk size, CPU usage, IP address, unique identifiers (including identifiers used for advertising purposes), crash data (if applicable), what device settings you’ve enabled, carrier, radio/network information (e.g., WiFi, LTE, 3G). (As described above, we may collect geolocation data from your device with your permission, or we may derive your general location, such as city, state or geographic area, from your IP address or other data.) Your device and software settings affect what information your device makes available to us.
•	Online activity data. Online activity data may include the date and time you visited, duration of access, the browser or app version you used (and its settings), the URLs you came from and went to, and how you used Newbee or interacted with our emails and other messages. For example, online activity data may include how and when you navigated within Newbee, and which links or features you clicked on, including advertising.
Some of the data collection described above is facilitated by cookies and similar technologies, as described in more detail in our Cookie Policy.

sections.body: Even if you have not registered for Newbee, Members may post or comment with personal information about you.

We use personal information for the following purposes:
2.1	Establish and develop community connections
We use personal information to identify and invite potential new Members to Newbee, and to set up new newcomer communities. For example, you can ask us to invite potential new Members to join Newbee on your behalf.  We do this by sending emails (including reminder emails). and.
2.2	Set you up on Newbee
To get Members started on Newbee, we use personal information to:
•	Confirm Member accounts using several techniques, including checking against third party data and public records, verification codes, or geo-verification. We may also use public registries to block registered sex offenders in the Germany and Türkiye (and other countries where permitted by law) from signing up for our Services. In some circumstances, we may ask for additional information (such as government-issued identification and business documentation) to confirm Member accounts.
•	Populate Member profiles and personalize your experience of Newbee.
•	Notify community of new Members as they join the Newbee.
•	Create and offer Business Services, which help Members learn about the businesses in their communities.
2.3	Provide and improve our Services
We use personal information, and both manual and automated systems, to analyze and use your Content and Member Content (and other information, including to:
•	Operate Newbee, create sub groups, suggest services and events, invite users, and improve our products and features.
•	Help you create, publish, view, share, and respond to Content, including highlighting interesting posts.
•	Highlight groups, community topics or other resources.
•	Administer and obtain feedback via surveys, contests, or other promotional activities.
•	Highlight businesses, ads, offers, products, and services you may be interested in.
•	Provide Business Services, such as enabling Business Pages and promotional services.
•	Provide third party services to facilitate your service bookings and understand your experience with them.
•	Personalize your experience of Newbee.
•	Understand trends, usage statistics, and demographic data relating to the Members and communities we serve.
•	Respond to your support requests and comments.
•	Test and evaluate potential new products and features on Newbee.
•	Diagnose and resolve problems, and monitor usage and resource needs.
•	Accept payments, through our third party payment processors.
•	Communicate with you about Newbee or our Services, including by sending announcements, updates, security alerts, and support messages via email, notifications, and text messages.
2.4	Create and maintain a trusted environment
We may use your information to help create and maintain a trusted environment on Newbee, including:
•	To detect and prevent fraud, spam, abuse, security incidents, and other harmful, unauthorized, unethical, illegal, or otherwise objectionable activity or content.
•	To conduct security investigations, audits, and risk assessments.
•	To comply with our legal obligations.
•	To confirm or authenticate information or identification.
2.5	Advertising
We use personal information to provide and improve advertisements and other commercial offerings both on and off our Services, including:
•	To help customize advertisements based on what we think may interest you.
•	To provide and measure the effectiveness of advertising, including whether it is interesting to Members and effective for the advertiser.
•	To send you promotional messages, marketing, advertising, and other information that we think may interest you.
•	To invite you to participate in events or other relevant opportunities.
We may customize advertising offers you see on Newbee based on information from our advertisers or vendors, on the demographics of your community, or on your actions, selections, or preferences on Newbee. For example, a home services company might provide a list of addresses eligible for a special deal that we may offer to Members who belong to that community. Our third party advertising partners also use cookies and similar technologies to collect information about Members for advertising purposes
2.6	Research and development
We use personal information for research and development purposes. As part of these activities, we may generate aggregated, deidentified and/or other anonymous data from personal information we collect. We do this by removing information that makes the data personally identifiable to you or other individuals. We may use this anonymous data and share it with third parties for lawful business purposes, including to analyze and improve our Services and promote Newbee.
2.7	Other purposes, with your permission
With your permission, we may also use personal information for purposes that are not specifically described here, but may be presented within the Services or in other documentation.
2.8	How Long Is My Personal Information Kept?
We retain personal information in our server logs, our databases, and our records for as long as necessary to provide our Services. We may need to retain some of your information for a longer period, such as in order to comply with our legal or regulatory obligations, to resolve disputes or defend against legal claims.

2.9	International Transfers of Personal Information
Newbee operates internationally, and your personal information may be transferred to and processed on servers outside the jurisdiction where you live. We typically transfer personal information to Türkiye, which is where Newbee is headquartered and where some of our Services are based.
Depending on where you live, your personal information may be transferred to jurisdictions other than your home country, including Türkiye, and those other jurisdictions may have different or less protective data protection laws than the jurisdiction where you live. In addition, the rights of authorities to access your personal information in other jurisdictions may not be the same as in your home jurisdiction.
By continuing to use Newbee, you understand and consent to the transfer and processing of your personal information outside your home country, which may have data protection rules that are different or less protective from those of your home country, including  Türkiye.
Newbee will only transfer personal data as permitted by law, and Newbee will only process personal information in accordance with this Privacy Policy. We will take steps designed to ensure appropriate protection of your personal information. If you have questions about international transfers of personal information, please info@beeyondapps.com.
For residents of Europe or countries with aligned data protection laws, additional information is provided in the jurisdiction-specific disclosures required under European data protection laws.

sections.body:

Newbee uses technical and organizational measures intended to keep your data secure, including using state of the art data transfer protocols to reduce the risk of unauthorized interception of your communications during your sessions in the application. However, the internet is not a fully secure environment and we cannot guarantee that personal information won’t be intercepted or improperly accessed. Please ensure that you keep your password safe and do not share it with anyone.

When using Newbee, you may come across links to websites and services operated by third parties that are not owned or controlled by Newbee (for example, if a Member shares a link to a video on YouTube, or if an advertiser provides a link to a contest or sweepstakes). This Privacy Policy does not apply to information collected on any third-party website or application that may link to or be accessible from our Services. These third parties have their own privacy policies, which govern any personal information they collect. We do not accept any responsibility or liability for such external websites’ privacy and security practices.
3.3	Personal Information Relating to Children
Children are not allowed to use our Services if they are under 13 years old or not old enough for Newbee to process their personal information without parental or age-specific consent in the place where they live. If you believe we may have collected personal information from a child in one of these categories, please contact us at info@beeyondapps.com for us to investigate and delete this information as appropriate.
sections.title: 3	How Is My Personal Information Protected?

sections.body:
We share personal information with other Members or other companies as follows:
4.1	Content you share on Newbee
Newbee is a platform that connects immigrants and expats around the world and facilitates their adaptation to their new home country... To that end, the Content you share on Newbee, such as posts, comments, recommendations, messages, events, and your profile information, may be visible to other Members, businesses, governments and agencies, or the public, including Visitors (people who have not registered for our Services but may still access parts of our Services, and search engines and this Content may include personal information.
4.2	Account confirmation
We may share personal information with our verification partners, such as telecommunications providers (if you choose to confirm your account by providing your telephone number) or other data providers, to try to make sure that you are who you say you are.
4.3	Legal and safety reasons
We may retain, preserve, or share your Content and personal information with law enforcement, government authorities, and private parties if we have a good-faith belief that it is reasonably necessary to: (a) respond, as required by applicable law, to a valid, binding legal request (e.g., a valid subpoena, search warrant, court order, or other legal process from government or law enforcement); (b) detect, investigate, prevent, and address fraud and other unauthorized, illegal or unethical activity, security, or technical issues; (c) protect our or others’ rights, property, or safety;
4.4	Advertising
If you view, click on, or reply to an advertisement or other offer on our Services, we may share your reply and limited Member information, both of which may contain personal information, with the advertiser. Additionally, we may log and share your interaction with online advertisements, for example as part of tracking the effectiveness of the advertisement. We may also pre-populate replies to ads you click on with your contact details, but those details are not shared with the advertiser without your consent.
Our Services are supported by advertising, including third party advertising networks. With your consent, our advertising partners use cookies and similar technologies to collect information about our Members and their devices over time across Newbee and other online services. Where permissible according to applicable law, we may share certain personal information, such as hashed emails and advertising identifiers, with our advertising partners that help serve targeted online advertising to those Members or to similar audiences. Our advertising partners may be able to associate this information with you based on your advertising identifiers or other personal information they have about you. Our advertising partners may then use the information they collect to provide our Members with customized ads on Newbee as well as on different websites and services, and to measure the effectiveness of their ads.
4.5	Third party partners
Newbee may partner with third parties that give Members the ability to book a range of different services. Offers for services may be integrated into Newbee, such as through Business Services, or Newbee may provide links to other websites or apps featuring the offers. In order to tailor offers for services to you, we may share personal information with these third parties, such as your community or city, the business topic of the content you are viewing, or a business search query (for example, a search for “plumber”). When you engage with one of these offers you or Newbee may share additional information (such as contact information) directly with the third party partner or their representative. If you engage with third party partners through Newbee, the third parties may share with us certain personal information about you to allow us to monitor, coordinate, assess, and improve our Services provided to you. This may include information about a booking you make with the third party, including type of service, name and address of provider, the time of booking, and your communications with the third party. These third parties may have their own privacy policies, which may apply to your activity if you click on or interact with their offers featured on Newbee or other websites or apps.
4.6	Service providers
We may also share personal information with service providers and/or data processors to help us operate, provide, improve, understand, customize, support, and market our Services. These service providers and data processors are contractually obligated to use personal information only to provide their service to us, and are contractually prohibited from using it for their own purposes. They provide a variety of services, including payment processing, information technology, generative artificial intelligence, cybersecurity, fraud prevention, hosting, customer relationship management and support, communications delivery, marketing, advertising, and website and mobile application analytics.
4.7	Social media
Our Services include certain social media features, including a social media share button. If you choose to share Content with personal information using this button, information about that Content will be shared with the selected social media platform.
4.8	Business reorganization
We may share personal information with the relevant participants in transactions (or potential transactions) involving a corporate divestiture, merger, consolidation, acquisition, restructuring, reorganization, or sale or other disposition of some or all of the assets of, or equity interests in Newbee or our affiliates (including, in connection with a bankruptcy or similar proceedings).
4.9	Professional advisors
We may share personal information with our professional advisors, such as lawyers, auditors, bankers and insurers, where necessary in the course of the professional services that they render to Newbee.
4.10	Payment processors
Any payment card information you use to make a purchase on our Services is collected and processed directly by our payment processor.
